# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.47 (pre-release)

A fresh build after pre.46 was published. **The program code is the same as pre.46**; only the version number and the dates changed, so a pre.46 install needs no update. Built and tried by the author's assistant on one Linux machine; the automated tests pass on CI runners. **Nothing was tried by hand on Windows, macOS or arm64.**

**Carried from pre.46**: picture zones drawn with the "Image" and "No image" pencils follow a page through its own keystone, so Mixed mode keeps the pictures on that page.

**Not verified**: the tester's photo in the window; Windows, macOS, arm64. On the macOS Intel runner (experimental) two PKCS#12 tests fail because of its OpenSSL, unrelated.
